rows.note: Use 責任 as the all-purpose everyday noun for an obligation or responsibility.

example.english: Looking after the house is my duty.
example.jyutping: ziu3 gu3 uk1 kei2 hai6 ngo5 ge3 zaak3 jam6

rows.note: Use 義務 for a clearly moral or legal obligation, rather than an ordinary assigned responsibility.

example.english: Following the law is every citizen's duty.
example.traditional: 遵守法律係每個公民嘅義務。
example.jyutping: zeon1 sau2 faat3 leot6 hai6 mui5 go3 gung1 man4 ge3 ji6 mou6

rows.note: Use 值班 for the work shift or state of being on duty and responsible for a task.

example.english: I'm on duty tonight, so I have to stay at the hospital.
example.traditional: 今晚我值班，要留喺醫院。
example.jyutping: gam1 maan5 ngo5 zik6 baan1 jiu3 lau4 hai2 ji1 jyun2

rows.note: Use 關稅 specifically for duty charged on imported or exported goods.

example.english: This shipment has to pay duty.
example.jyutping: ni1 pai1 fo3 jiu3 gaau1 gwaan1 seoi3
